sections.shortTitle: Lahore University of Biological and Applied Sciences Act 2023
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 9
PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 9
ACT IV OF 2023
LAHORE UNIVERSITY OF BIOLOGICAL AND APPLIED
SCIENCES ACT, 2023
An Act to provide for the establishment of the Lahore University of
Biological and Applied Sciences
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,8th February, 2023]
No. PAP/Legis-3(116)/2022/97, dated 8.2.2023.---The Lahore University of Biological and Applied
Sciences Bill 2022, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab
on the 11th day of January 2023, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab
on the 23rd day of January 2023, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
WHEREAS it is expedient to provide for
the establishment of the Lahore University of Biological and Applied Sciences
in the private sector and to provide for matters connected therewith and
ancillary thereto;
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Lahore University of Biological and Applied Sciences
Act, 2023.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

3. Establishment
of the University.---(1) The
Government shall, by notification, in the official gazette, establish the
Lahore University of Biological and Applied Sciences, in the private sector,
with its campus located at Lahore.
(2) The
University shall be a body corporate having perpetual succession and a common
seal with power to acquire, hold and dispose of property and shall, by the said
name, sue and be sued.

No. PAP/Legis-3(116)/2022/97, dated 8.2.2023.---The Lahore University of Biological and Applied
Sciences Bill 2022, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab
on the 11th day of January 2023, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab

Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
WHEREAS it is expedient to provide for
the establishment of the Lahore University of Biological and Applied Sciences
in the private sector and to provide for matters connected therewith and
ancillary thereto;
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab as follows:
4. Functions
and Powers of the University.---The
University shall have the Powers to:
(a) provide
instructions and training in Applied Health Sciences, Allied Health Sciences,
Public Health Sciences, Social Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biological
Sciences, Medical and Dental Sciences, Nursing, Sciences of Human Body and Mind
and any other branches of knowledge, as may be Prescribed and, where
applicable, subject to the prior approval of the relevant statutory body of
professional education;
(b) decide
teaching methods and strategies including virtual, on-campus, online, distance
learning, etc. in a such manner as may be Prescribed to ensure the most
effective educational and training programs;
(c) provide
for instruction, training, courses of study and curriculum for the academic
programs offered by the University and their allied branches of knowledge as
may be Prescribed from time to time;
(d) provide
for research, demonstration and other services, and for the advancement and
dissemination of knowledge;
(e) hold
examinations and confer on, award or withdraw degrees, honorary degrees,
diplomas, certificates, prizes and other academic distinctions to persons who
have passed its examinations;
(f) establish,
maintain, manage, regulate, regularize and administer Authorities of the
University, Faculties, Departments, Colleges, Hospitals, other educational and
research facilities, laboratories, organizations, bodies (including corporate
bodies), trusts, and such other facilities as may be prescribed from time to
time;
(g) start
Sandwich Programs and Split Programs between National and International
Universities and to collaborate with other educational institutions in all
academic matters;
(h) accept
an examination and period of study spent by a student of the University at any
other university or place of learning and prescribe conditions for such
acceptance or withdrawal;
(i) publish
research papers and other documents and get Intellectual Property Rights
registered and protected under the relevant laws and to license them for
consideration;
(j) admit
students as per prescribed criteria, fix and demand fees and other charges from
the students as may be prescribed by the Board from time to time. To provide
for financial assistance, scholarships and awards for the deserving students;
(k) affiliate
other educational institutions, establish Constituent Colleges and otherwise
admit any educational institution to the University's privileges or withdraw
such privileges and to determine and demand such fees etc. as may be prescribed
for the said admission and/or related to the University's privileges;
(l) engage,
employ and appoint person(s) on such posts/designations on such terms and
conditions as may be required for the operations of the University;
(m) hold
and dispose of property; enter into agreements for property and equipment,
including sale/purchase agreements, lease agreements, mortgages, finance
agreements etc. in a manner as may be required for the operations and benefits
of the Un

9. Inspection
and inquiry.---(1) The Chancellor
may direct inspection or inquiry into the affairs of the University.
(2) The
Chancellor shall convey his views with regard to the result of the inspection
or inquiry to the Board and may, after ascertaining the views of the Board,
recommend any remedial action to the Board.
(3) The
Board shall, within the time specified by the Chancellor, submit a report to
the Chancellor about the action taken on the recommendations of the Chancellor.
(4) If
the Board fails to take action to the satisfaction of the Chancellor within the
specified time, the Chancellor may issue such directions as he thinks fit and
the Board shall comply with the directions.
(5) The
Chancellor may, on the recommendation of a Committee constituted by him and
comprising of a nominee of the Board, a nominee of Higher Education Department
not below the rank of Additional Secretary and a Professor Emeritus or Vice
Chancellor of any university, take such action against the University as he may
deem appropriate.
(6) The
Chancellor shall not take any action under subsection (5), unless the
Chairperson of the Board is afforded an opportunity of hearing.
(7) The
Chancellor may set aside a decision or action of the Board, which, in the
considered opinion of the Chancellor, is against the objectives of the
University or against the interest of academic excellence, religious or
cultural ideology or national integrity.

Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of

10. Board
of Governors.---(1) The Board of
Governors of the University shall consist of the following:-
(a) Chairperson
of the Board shall be the Chairperson of the Board of Directors of the Company
or any other person nominated by him;
(b) Members
of the Board of Directors of the Company subject to a maximum number of ten
Members;
(c) Five
persons including at least two women from eminent medical practitioners,
scholars, professionals, academicians or prominent citizens nominated by the
Chairperson of the Board of Directors of the Company;
(d) Chairperson,
Higher Education Commission or his nominee;
(e) Chairperson,
Punjab Higher Education Commission or his nominee;
(f) Vice
Chancellor of a University nominated by the Chairperson of the Board of
Directors of the Company;
(g) Secretary
to the Government of the Punjab, Higher Education Department or his nominee not
below the rank of an Additional Secretary; and
(h) Such
other persons as may be nominated by the Chairperson of the Board.
(2) The
quorum for a meeting of the Board shall be one half of the total number of
Board members, a fraction being counted as one.
(3) The
members of the Board, other than ex-officio members, shall hold office for a
term of four years and shall be eligible for re-appointment on the expiry of
their term of office.
(4) The
respective appointing authority for the members of the Board shall
also have the
power to remove
the member so appointed.
(5) The
Board shall take decision by majority of the votes of members present.
(6) All
agreements, contracts and ancillary documents of the University, involving
financial terms and liabilities, shall be executed by the Chairperson of the
Board (or his nominee), on behalf of the University.
(7) The
Chairperson may fill a casual vacancy occurring because of death, resignation
or inability to perform duties as a member of the Board other than ex-officio
member to the extent of the remainder of the term, of the former member.

11. Powers
and Duties of the Board.---(1) The
administration, management, regulation of all matters and affairs of the
University, including academic, financial and administrative matters, shall
vest in the Board.
(2) The
Board shall oversee the Authorities, Bodies and Committees of the University
and shall have the powers to direct such Authorities etc. in any matter related
to the affairs of the University. The Board shall make, prescribe, approve,
amend or repeal the Statutes (including the First Statutes), Regulations, Rules
or Proceedings of the University and such Statutes, Regulations, Rules etc.
shall not become invalid merely by the reason of any vacancy or defect in the
constitution of the Board.

Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
WHEREAS it is expedient to provide for
the establishment of the Lahore University of Biological and Applied Sciences
in the private sector and to provide for matters connected therewith and
ancillary thereto;
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab as follows:
21. Powers
and Duties of Academic Council.---(1)
The Academic Council shall be the academic body of the University which shall
recommend academic standards, modes of instruction, research, publication and
examination to the Board. The Academic Council shall, subject to approval of
the Board, regulate and promote the academic life of the University.
(2) Without
prejudice to the generality of the foregoing powers and subject to the
provisions of this Act, Statutes, Regulations, Rules etc. the Academic Council
may:
(a) Advise
the Board on all academic matters;
(b) Regulate
the conduct of teaching, research and examinations;
(c) Propose
for each academic session, on the recommendations of the Boards of Studies,
Board of Faculties regulations prescribing the courses of studies, syllabi,
curriculum and the outlines of tests for all examinations;
(d) Regulate
the admission of students to the courses of studies and examinations in the
University;
(e) Recommend
to the Board, teaching examination systems including not limited to semester or
annual system;
(f) Regulate
the conduct and discipline of the students and prescribe punishment or fines on
misconduct;
(g) Propose
to the Board, schemes for the constitution, operation and organization of the
Faculties, Teaching Departments, Constituent Colleges, Affiliated Colleges,
Sub-Campuses and Institutes;
(h) Formulate
Proposals for Planning and Development of Teaching and Research in the
University;
(i) Recommend
the Regulations to the Board prescribing the Courses of Studies, the Syllabi
and the Outlines of Tests for the University Examinations;
(j) Regulate
the award of studentships, scholarships, exhibitions, medals and prizes;
(k) Recommend
Regulations to the Board for approval; appoint or nominate members to various
Authorities in accordance with the provisions of this Act; and
(l) Perform
such other functions as may be prescribed and determined by the Board and/or
Vice Chancellor in accordance with the provisions of this Act.

SCHEDULE
THE FIRST STATUTES
1. Faculties.---The
University shall include the following Faculties:-
(a) Faculty
of Applied Health Sciences;
(b) Faculty
of Allied Health Sciences;
(c) Faculty
of Public Health Sciences;
(d) Faculty
of Social Sciences;
(e) Faculty
of Pharmaceutical Sciences;
(f) Faculty
of Biological Sciences;
(g) Faculty
of Medical and Dental Sciences;
(h) Faculty
of Nursing;
(i) Faculty
of Sciences of Human Body and Mind;
(j) Faculty
of Basic and Applied Sciences; and
(k) Such
other Faculties as may be approved by the Board.
2. Board
of Faculty.---(1) The Board of
Faculty shall consist of:
(a) Dean
of the Faculty (Chairperson);
(b) Professors
and Heads of Departments;
(c) Two
Teachers, to be nominated by the Academic Council owing to their specialized
knowledge of the subjects which, though not assigned to the Faculty, have in
the opinion of the Academic Council, important bearing on the subjects assigned
to the Faculty;
(d) Two
experts, in the field from outside the University to be appointed by the Board;
(e) One
member to be nominated by the Vice Chancellor; and
(f) Director
Quality Enhancement Cell (QEC).
(2) The
members other than Ex-Officio Members of a Board of Faculty hold office for a
period of three years.
(3) The
Quorum for a meeting of a Board of Faculty shall be one half of the total
number of the members.
(4) A
Board of Faculty, subject to the general control of the Academic Council and
the Board as may be Prescribed:
(a) Co-ordinate
the teaching and research work in the subjects assigned to the Faculty Members;
(b) Scrutinize
the recommendations of a Board of Studies with regard to the appointment of
paper-setters and examiners for graduate and postgraduate examinations and to
forward the panels of suitable paper-setters and examiners for each examination
to the Vice Chancellor;
(c) Consider
any other academic matter relating to the Faculty and to submit its report to
the Academic Council;
(d) Prepare
a comprehensive annual report regarding the performance of each Department,
Faculty, Constituent College, Affiliated College, Sub-Campus or Institute for
presentation to the Academic Council; and
(e) Perform
such other functions as may be prescribed by the Board, Statutes, Regulations
and Rules.
(5) The
Dean of the Faculty shall be the Chairperson and convener of the Board of
Faculty.
(6) The
Dean shall be appointed by the Board of Governors on such terms as it may
determine on the recommendations of the Vice Chancellor from amongst the
Professors of the Faculty.
(7) The
Dean shall present candidates, for admission to a Degree, except an Honorary
Degree.
(8) The
Dean shall have such powers and duties as may be prescribed by the Board on the recommendations of the Vice
Chancellor.
